method: On one fixed fine state and published base mode, compare eager/JIT construction of the combined NQC amplitude/basis product array. Then pass the exact eager combined array to separately eager and JIT barrier-spline row evaluations and the unchanged equilibrated amplitude solve. Compare coefficient changes with fixed combined input versus changed combined input.
interpretation: This is attribution, not a source-preserving whole-waveform candidate. Any pass remains development-only until source, whole-waveform, AD/FD, multi-case and physical gates pass.
